model.label: WorldScape Policy 2.5-Preview
model.inputs: Overhead and wrist RGB, robot joint positions, and task instruction
model.trainingSetting: One 60,000-step multitask checkpoint trained across all 26 Bench2Dex tasks.
model.evaluationSetting: 26 tasks, four channels, 50 episodes per task/channel; fixed checkpoint; 60 Hz physics and 20 Hz policy control.

protocol.expertReference: Native per-episode expert_time_step in physics steps.
protocol.protocolChanges: The evaluator adds a remote WSP2 bridge for joint-position control, overhead and wrist RGB, and scene-level language instructions. GPU simulation ran with PhysX continuous collision detection (CCD) disabled. The xArm7 + Ability setup uses the enabled colliders authored in the robot USD. Local runtime changes also adjust camera resource cleanup and RPC framing. None, Equi., and Inv. use replay anchors, and Full samples initial states without replay anchors. Each task/channel runs in two 25-episode batches appended to the same native log.

aggregation.sr: Stable successes divided by scored episodes, averaged equally across channels and tasks.
aggregation.lscr: Mean native latched stage completion rate including failures, averaged equally across channels and tasks.
aggregation.efficiency: Per-task expert steps divided by mean steps over all successful episodes pooled across channels, then averaged across eligible tasks.
aggregation.errors: All 5,200 scored episodes retained, including failures. The native summaries report zero error episodes.
